name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger?
description: Make a small bathroom feel larger by using large tiles, big mirrors, light colors, and recessed storage to reduce clutter and reflect light.

mainEntity.name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small bathroom feel larger, focus on visual tricks and space-saving solutions. Incorporate large format tiles with minimal grout lines to reduce visual clutter, use a large mirror to reflect light and expand the perception of space, and choose a light, neutral color scheme. Consider adding recessed shelving or a niche in the shower for storage without encroaching on floor space. These design elements are effective for creating an open feel, especially in the smaller homes prevalent in our service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Make a small bathroom feel larger by using large tiles, big mirrors, light colors, and recessed storage to reduce clutter and reflect light.
